<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par43 />and serve to express states and qualities, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=כָּבֵד|translate=to be heavy}}, {{GHGheb|text=קָטֹן|translate=to be small}}.

In Paradigm B a verb ''middle a'', a verb ''middle ē'', and a verb ''middle ō'' are accordingly given side by side. The second example {{GHGheb|text=כָּבֵד}} is chosen as showing, at the same time, when the {{GHGterm|Dageš lene}} is to be inserted or omitted.

{{GHGmargin-letter|43|b}}
Rem. 1. The vowel of the second syllable is the principal vowel, and hence on it depends the distinction between the transitive and intransitive meaning. The {{GHGterm|Qameṣ}} of the first syllable is lengthened from an original ''ă'' (cf. Arabic ''qătălă''), but it can be retained in Hebrew only immediately before the tone, or at the most (with an open ultima) in the counter-tone with {{GHGterm|Metheg}}; otherwise, like all the pretonic vowels (''ā'', ''ē''), it becomes {{GHGterm|Š<sup>e</sup>wâ}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=קְטַלְתֶּ֫ם}} 2nd ''plur. masc.'' In the Aramaic dialects the vowel of the first syllable is always reduced to Š<sup>e</sup>wâ, as {{GHGheb|text=קְטַל}}=Hebr. {{GHGheb|text=קָטַל}}. The intransitive forms in Arabic are ''qătĭlă'', ''qătŭlă''; in Hebrew (after the rejection of the final vowel) ''ĭ'' being in the tone-syllable has been regularly lengthened to ''ē'', and ''ŭ'' to ''ō''.

{{GHGmargin-letter|43|c}}
2. Examples of ''denominatives'' in {{GHGterm|Qal}} are: {{GHGheb|text=חָמַר|translate=to cover with pitch}}, from {{GHGheb|text=חֵמָר|translate=pitch}}; {{GHGheb|text=מָלַח|translate=to salt}}, from {{GHGheb|text=מֶ֫לַח|translate=salt}}; {{GHGheb|text=שָׁבַר}} (usually ''Hiph.'') ''to buy'' or ''sell corn'', from {{GHGheb|text=שֶׁ֫בֶר|translate=corn}}; see above, {{GHGpar|38|c}}.<section end=par43 />
<section begin=par44 />{{GHGpar-heading|44|Flexion of the Perfect of Qal||<ref>Cf. Nöldeke, ‘Die Endungen des Perfects’ (''Untersuchungen zur semit''. Gramm. ii.), in {{GHGcite|title={{abbr|ZDMG.|Zeitschrift der deutschen morgenländischen Gesellschaft, Lpz. 1846 ff., since 1903 ed. by A. Fischer.}}}} vol. 38, p. 407 ff., and more fully in {{GHGcite|title=Beiträge zur sem. Sprachwiss.}}, Strassb. 1904, p. 15 ff.</ref>}}
{{GHGmargin-letter|44|a}}
'''1.''' The formation of the persons of the Perfect is effected by the addition of certain forms of the personal pronoun, and marks of the 3rd fem. sing. and 3rd pl. (as ''afformatives'') to the ''end'' of the verbal-stem, which contains the idea of a predicate, and may be regarded, in meaning if not in form, as a {{GHGterm|Participle}} or {{GHGterm|verbal adjective}}. For the 3rd ''pers. sing. masc. Perfect'', the pronominal or subject idea inherent in the finite verb is sufficient: thus, {{GHGheb|text=קָטַל|translate=he has killed}}, {{GHGheb|text=קָטַ֫לְ־תָּ|translate=thou hast killed}} (as it were, ''killing thou'', or ''a killer thou''), ''a killer wast thou''={{GHGheb|text=קטל אַתָּה}}; {{GHGheb|text=יָרֵא|translate=he was fearing}}, {{GHGheb|text=יְרֵא־תֶם|translate=ye were fearing}}={{GHGheb|text=ירא אַתֶּם}}. The ending of the 1st pers. plur. ({{GHGheb|text=־נוּ}}) is also certainly connected with the termination of {{GHGheb|text=אֲנַ֫חְנוּ}}, {{GHGheb|text=אנו|translate=we}} ({{GHGpar|32|b}}, d). The afformative of the 1st pers. sing. ({{GHGheb|text=תִּי}}) is to be referred, by an interchange of {{GHGheb|text=כ‍}} and {{GHGheb|text=ת}} (cf. {{GHGpar|33|f}}), to that form of the pronoun which also underlies {{GHGheb|text=אָֽנֹכִי}}, I.<ref>According to Nöldeke, ''l.c.'', p. 419, the original Semitic termination of the 1st sing. Perf. was most probably ''kû''; cf. the Ethiopic ''qatalku'', Arabic ''qataltu''.</ref> In the ''third'' person {{GHGheb|text=־ָה}} (originally {{GHGheb|text=־ַת}}, cf. below, f) is the mark of the feminine, as in a great number of nouns ({{GHGpar|80|c}}), and {{GHGheb|text=וּ}} is the termination of the plural; cf., for the latter, the termination of the 3rd and 2nd pers. plur. Imperf. ''ûna'' in Arabic and ''û'' (often also {{GHGheb|text=וּן}})<section end=par44 /><noinclude>
